translations.translatedText: # Friday 4.9.2020 (radio)

The Centre elects its chairperson on Saturday. The police have been sentenced for assault in a police cell. A Vincent van Gogh exhibition opens at the Didrichsen Art Museum. The weather is warm, but rainy.
## The Centre elects its chairperson

![Debate of the candidates for chairperson of the Centre Party in Helsinki in August 2020.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4000,h_2250,x_0,y_419/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7136995f4ce98eca786/1598876384)
Open image viewer

The chairperson of the Centre is voted on on Saturday. The current chairperson Katri Kulmuni has to fight hard for her position against Minister of Science and Culture Annika Saarikko. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
The Centre is holding a party congress at the weekend. At the congress the Centre will elect a new chairperson. The chairperson will be chosen tomorrow, Saturday.
There are 4 candidates for the chairperson of the Centre.

According to a survey, the favourite is Minister of Science and Culture Annika Saarikko. The current chairperson Katri Kulmuni wants to continue as chairperson. Vice Chairperson Petri Honkonen and entrepreneur Ilkka Tiainen also want to lead the Centre.
## The police were sentenced for assault in a police cell
![Starting image of the putka video](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11527217)
Open image viewer

The Päijät-Häme District Court has sentenced a senior constable of the Häme Police Department to a conditional prison sentence of one year and four months for aggravated assault and breach of official duty.
The District Court has given a sentence for an assault that happened in a police station cell. The police officer was sentenced. The sentence is a conditional prison sentence.

The assault happened at the Lahti police station in 2019. The police brought a man into the cell early in the morning. The man resisted the police, and the police put handcuffs on him. At the same time the man got bruises and his nose was broken.
The District Court says that the police used too much force.
## Prime Minister Sanna Marin is the patron of Helsinki Pride

![Prime Minister Sanna Marin spoke to the media on arriving at the negotiations on travel restrictions at the Säätytalo in Helsinki on 3 September.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11525185)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Sanna Marin speaking to the media on arriving at the negotiations on travel restrictions at the Säätytalo in Helsinki on 3 September. Photo: Antti Aimo-Koivisto / Lehtikuva
Prime Minister Sanna Marin is the patron of Helsinki Pride this year and next year. Pride is an event for sexual and gender minorities.
For the first time, the patron of Helsinki Pride is the Prime Minister of Finland. This year the event is held unusually in the autumn, that is 7-13 September.
At Helsinki Pride there is no big parade this year because of the corona situation.
## Van Gogh exhibition in Helsinki
![Vincent van Gogh drawing](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11522337)
Open image viewer
Vincent van Gogh's painting Self-portrait from 1887. Photo: Vincent van Gogh: van Gogh. Collection: Kröller-Müller Museum, Otterlo, Netherlands. Photo: Rik Klein Gotink

On Saturday, an exhibition by the painter Vincent van Gogh opens at the Didrichsen Art Museum in Helsinki. Vincent van Gogh is a famous Dutch artist who lived in the 1800s. He painted country people, work and landscapes.
The exhibition in Helsinki has about 40 paintings. The paintings are borrowed from a Dutch museum. The exhibition is open until the end of January.
## The weather is rainy
![Rainy Evijärvi](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1920,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7117705f45074d589bd/1598359471)
Open image viewer
The weather at the weekend is rainy. Photo: Pasi Takkunen / Yle
The weekend is warm, but rainy.

It rains now and then across the whole country. During Saturday evening it rains a lot in the south. The highest temperature during the day varies between about 20 degrees in the south and 10 degrees in the north.
